vintage: INSEE/STSEE recensement de Wallis-et-Futuna 2023, Insee Première 2021 (published 2024-10-24)
methodology: Wallis-et-Futuna's three circonscriptions are distributed over commune polygons and weighted within hexes. Population-change rates are circonscription-level; age and labour-market indicators are published at island level, so Alo and Sigave share the Futuna value. The rest of France is null because these are territory-specific census tables.
